description.raw: '''Innate:''' Periodically, '''Vi's''' next [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]] hit grants her a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] equal to 12% of her '''maximum''' health for 3 seconds.
description.text: Innate: Periodically, Vi's next ability hit grants her a shield equal to 12% of her maximum health for 3 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Blast Shield's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds each time ''[[File:Vi Denting Blows.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Denting Blows|An icon for Vi's ability Denting Blows]] [[Vi#Denting Blows|Denting Blows]]'' is consumed.
description2.text: Blast Shield's  cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds each time Denting Blows is consumed.

notes.raw: * ''[[File:Vi Vault Breaker.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Vault Breaker|An icon for Vi's ability Vault Breaker]] [[Vi#Vault Breaker|Vault Breaker]]'' will trigger ''Blast Shield'' even if it's blocked by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]].(bug) ** ''[[File:Vi Cease and Desist.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Cease and Desist|An icon for Vi's ability Cease and Desist]] [[Vi#Cease and Desist|Cease and Desist]]'' will not. * ''[[File:Vi Denting Blows.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Denting Blows|An icon for Vi's ability Denting Blows]] [[Vi#Denting Blows|Denting Blows]]'' will not activate ''Blast Shield''.
notes.text:
Vault Breaker will trigger Blast Shield even if it's blocked by a spell shield.(bug)
* Cease and Desist will not.
Denting Blows will not activate Blast Shield.
